$comment: Ders/kurs içerik katmanı — Ostinato library.json / JabLab library_test.dart desenini uyarlar (M-F-103/108).
Kütüphane -> Hareket sayfası -> Kurs -> Ders (W0-BILGI-MIMARISI §1). Her hareket KENDİ sayfası.
ELLE YAZILAN İDDİA YOKTUR: her lesson'ın açık/kilitli olması bir ÖLÇÜME dayanır ve
tools/validate_library.py bunu mekanik olarak denetler (LLM-denetim değil, aile kuralı).
DÜRÜSTLÜK KURALLARI (validate_library.py):
1. status=coming_soon olan harekette KURS OLAMAZ (sahte kurs listelenmez).
2. Her kursun en az 1 dersi olmak zorunda (boş kurs listelenmez).
3. Ders, katalogda BULUNMAYAN formError'a atıf yapamaz.
4. Her harekette honesty bloku ZORUNLU (measurementContract'ten türer, elle yazılmaz — W0 §3).
5. status=locked olan her ders lockedReason taşımak zorunda; lockedReason EŞİK DEĞERİ değil,
EKSİK ÖLÇÜMÜN adı olmalı.
6. comingSoon maddeleri gerekçesiz olamaz.
--- Gravita'ya ÖZEL iki kural (kopya değil, aynı gerekçenin bu ürüne düşen hâli): ---
7. gradesFormAgainstReference=true olan bir ders AÇIK olamaz, eğer hareketin
provenance.derivedJoints listesi BOŞSA. Gerekçe G-050/G-014: taban-bağlı (floor) tolerans
VARYANS-TÜRETİMLİ SAYILMAZ; eğitmenlerin ne kadar ayrıştığı ölçülmemişken form notu vermek,
ölçümden değil varsayılandan gelen bir sayıyı kullanıcıya hüküm olarak sunmaktır.
8. status=live olan bir harekette engine.precondition.status DERIVED olmak zorunda.
Gerekçe G-043: kimlik ön koşulu yoksa tekrar FSM'i hareketi değil salınımı sayar
(ayakta konuşan birinin dizi de bükülür). ⚠️ Bu kural, `preconditionStatus` beyanının
ÜRÜN tarafındaki İLK tüketicisidir — beşinci canlılık sorusu (G-059).
Ürün dili İngilizce (PRD §7, V1 yalnız `en`); bu $comment iç dokümandır.

movements.blurb: Set your phone down side-on so it can see you from head to heels. We count your reps, time your tempo, and tell you when a rep didn't go deep enough.

measured: Rep count — the engine refuses to count unless your torso is actually horizontal (identity gate, G-043)
Tempo (down/up timing) — measured from the real turnaround point, not from a threshold crossing (G-055)
Elbow range of motion per rep
Whether a rep was too shallow (partial_rom fires on real footage — replay gate, 8/8 rules live)
notMeasured: How your form compares to instructors — we harvested 5 instructors but NONE of the 9 joint tolerances came out of their measured disagreement yet (all 9 are still at the default floor). Until that changes we count and time your reps, we do not grade your shape against a reference.

courses.goal: Get honest rep counting and tempo on your push-up, and learn which depth actually counts.

lessons._why_unlocked: Bu dersin dayandığı üç ölçüm de CANLI: (1) kimlik ön koşulu DERIVED ve üründe aktif (torso_angle_from_vertical>=60, G-043 — ayakta el hareketi tekrar SAYILMIYOR, testi var); (2) rep FSM 69/69 test yeşil ve replay kapısında push_up'ın 8 biriminin 8'i GERÇEK veride ateşleniyor, 0 ölü; (3) tempo eşik geçişinden değil gerçek dönüş anından ölçülüyor (G-055) — yani sayım eşiği değişse tempo bozulmuyor. partial_rom İSİMLİ ürün eşiği (110°) ve G-054'ten beri gerçek veride ateşleniyor. Hiçbiri referans toleransına bağlı DEĞİL.

lessons.lockedReason: We can see your body line, but we can't grade it yet. We harvested 5 independent instructors — and every one of the 9 joint tolerances still sits at our default floor value, because the instructors' own measured spread came out narrower than that floor. That means a 'good line' number would come from our default, not from real instructors. We won't score you against that. Rep counting and depth are unaffected and stay open.

comingSoonInThisMovement: Body-line grading (hip sag / pike / head drop / uneven press) — the rules fire correctly on real footage, but no joint tolerance is variance-derived yet (derivedJoints is empty; all 9 floor-bound, G-014/G-050), so we show the cue and never a score
Side-dependent cues ("your left arm is...") — the pose model's left/right labels are not trustworthy in this camera setup, so all rules stay side-agnostic (ADR-003 / G-007)
Hand pressure and load — a single camera cannot see either; this is a permanent limit, not a pending measurement

movements.blurb: Squat coaching isn't open yet. We have the movement rules written, but we haven't finished proving them — details below, in plain terms.

notMeasured: Nothing is graded yet. Three separate things are still missing, and each one alone is enough for us to keep this closed.

We have no instructor reference. Of 27 harvested squat videos only 4 passed source-eligibility, they come from just 3 instructors, and those 3 do not agree with each other — not at our normal tolerance and not at double it. So we cannot yet say what a correct squat looks like (G-069/G-070).

The engine has no squat identity check. For push-ups we verify your torso is horizontal before counting a rep; the equivalent test for squats hasn't been derived, so nothing stops a rep being counted while you're just standing and moving (G-043).
The squat error rules have never been run against real footage — there is no replay fixture for this movement, so we have no evidence they fire when they should.
Knee tracking side-to-side (valgus) — that needs a front-facing camera, not this setup. Permanent limit for this setup, not a pending measurement.
Weight distribution across the foot, force, or load — a single camera cannot see these.

comingSoonInThisMovement: Rep counting and depth — blocked on the identity precondition (engine.precondition.status is 'pending', conditions list empty), because counting reps without an identity check counts limb swing, not squats (G-043)

Depth and torso-angle grading — blocked on having any instructor reference at all; the only 3 eligible instructors disagree beyond twice our clustering tolerance (G-069), and how source-eligibility should be decided is itself under review (G-070)

Butt wink (lower-back rounding at the bottom) — the lumbar proxy metric carries landmark jitter risk at deep flexion and is marked pendingVerification, so it would not be graded even once a reference exists
